description: 655 million people lived without electricity in 2024, according to Tracking SDG7: The Energy Progress Report 2026.

title: Brighten Haiti
description: Brighten Haiti (Haiti): 42 lights shipped. Brings solar power to schools, hospitals and families across Haiti through Solar4Schools.

title: Loksadhana
description: Loksadhana (India): 15 lights allocated, not shipped. A charitable trust in Maharashtra advancing rural education, women’s empowerment and health.

title: Malaika
description: Malaika (DR Congo): 15 lights allocated, not shipped. Empowers girls and communities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo through education, health and clean water.
